title: fix(ui): give the Control UI startup fallback the app shell
body:
The parent holding-screen change (#191935) has landed. This PR now targets `main` and contains only its fallback layer; land it after #193874.

## What Problem This Solves

When the Control UI bundle fails to start, the static recovery page looks disconnected from the rest of the app.

## User Impact

The fallback uses the approved placeholder app shell, OpenClaw mascot, and responsive wordmark. Once automatic recovery stops, it shows “Control UI didn’t start,” a Reload button, and a Troubleshooting link. “Keep waiting” is removed; a late first render still retires the fallback automatically. Reduced motion stops the body, claws, shadow, and lids while slowing the eye movement to 12 seconds.

## Why This Change Was Made

The static page stays self-contained so it can explain and recover from a failed app bundle. Bounded recovery navigations, unsupported-browser retirement, native background dragging, and reloading the current URL are preserved.

## Evidence

Previously captured and inspected before/after images use the registered-but-never-rendered app fixture in Chromium at 2x. The original baseline is shown below. Reused under the approved recapture waiver: preparation made a clean ancestry-only rebase and formatter-only edits, with no layout or behavior changes.

Current preparation checks: all 32 existing mount-fallback unit cases passed (one worker, 4.49 s wall); UI production types and the app, components, and E2E test type shards passed. Focused typed lint, four-file formatting, inline JavaScript syntax, CSS parsing, normalized-DOM parity, source-line guards, test-line budget (81 lines of slack), and `git diff --check` passed. The test layer shrinks by 10 lines; no tests or allowances were added.

The initial type/lint attempt found incomplete copied workspace dependency links; both passed after restoring the matching package dependencies. Existing browser and visual proof is retained. No fresh E2E suite, screenshots, or full build were run for this mechanical preparation. CSS/JS budget exceptions remain operator-authorized; no new bundle-size measurement is claimed. Hosted CI and ordered landing remain with the parent; this preparation does not enable auto-merge.
